title: The quotient categories ]X/G[ and [X/G]
body_html:
The quotient categories $]X/G[$ and $[X/G]$

Let $G$ act cellularly on $X$.

Definition. The category $]X/G[$ has

  • objects: the cells of $X$;
  • morphisms: $\Hom_{]X/G[}(E,E') := \{g \in G : gE \preceq E'\}$;
  • composition: the group law of $G$.

We write $g : E \to E'$ for the morphism corresponding to $g \in \Hom_{]X/G[}(E,E')$. The opposite category is $[X/G] := ]X/G[^{\mathrm{op}}$, so

$$\Hom_{[X/G]}(E',E) = \{g \in G : E \preceq gE'\}.$$

For the trivial group, $]X/\{e\}[ \,=\, ]X[$ (see [[node:cellular_categories.category_jXk]]).
